key_insight: RefVFX enables tuning-free, feed-forward transfer of complex temporal effects (e.g., dynamic lighting, character transformations) from a reference video onto a target video or image while preserving the target's identity and temporal coherence.
problem_solved: Existing editing methods struggle to reproduce rich, time-varying visual effects described neither by text nor static keyframes; this work addresses how to capture and apply dynamic temporal behavior from one video to another without per-video fine-tuning.
method: Extract a compact temporal-effect descriptor from the reference video that encodes dynamic changes (appearance, lighting, transformations).
Use a feed-forward generator that conditions target frames on the descriptor to inject the reference dynamics into the target sequence without per-video tuning.
Incorporate temporal-consistency mechanisms and losses to preserve semantics, identity, and smooth frame-to-frame transitions during transfer.
impact: Provides a practical, fast way to copy complex moving effects between videos/images, enabling content creators and ML practitioners to perform realistic temporal edits without slow per-video optimization or hand-crafted prompts.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram: reference video -> temporal-effect extractor -> feed-forward generator -> edited target video (annotated modules and data flow).
Before/after montage: side-by-side frames or short clips showing the target video pre- and post-effect transfer.
Temporal consistency chart: frame-wise error or perceptual similarity across time comparing RefVFX vs baseline methods.
Icon set: small symbols for 'no fine-tuning', 'real-time / feed-forward', 'preserved identity', and 'dynamic effects' to quickly convey key advantages.
paper_title: Tuning-free Visual Effect Transfer across Videos
paper_authors: Maxwell Jones, Rameen Abdal, Or Patashnik, Ruslan Salakhutdinov, Sergey Tulyakov
